title: No Helmet (Rider & Pillion)
desc: Riding a two-wheeler without a protective ISI mark helmet for both the rider and pillion passenger.

title: Drunk Driving
desc: Driving under the influence of alcohol (BAC > 30mg/100ml of blood). Offender must appear in court.

title: Red Light Violation - Chennai Zone
desc: Jumping a red traffic signal within Greater Chennai limits captured by ANPR cameras.

title: Heavy Vehicle City Entry Restrictions
desc: Heavy commercial vehicles entering city limits during peak hours (8 AM - 11 AM & 4 PM - 8 PM).

title: Triple Riding
desc: More than two persons riding on a two-wheeler.

title: No PUC Certificate
desc: Driving without a valid Pollution Under Control certificate. Vehicle can be seized if emitting excessive smoke.

title: Using Mobile Phone while Driving
desc: Talking, texting, or watching videos on a mobile phone while operating a vehicle.

title: No Seatbelt
desc: Driver or front-seat passenger not wearing a seatbelt.

title: Driving Without Insurance
desc: Operating a motor vehicle on public roads without valid third-party insurance.

title: Driving Without License
desc: Operating a motor vehicle without a valid driving license or with an expired license.

title: Auto Rickshaw - Refusal to Ply / No Meter
desc: Refusing to take passengers to a destination or refusing to use the digital fare meter.

title: Over Speeding (Light Motor Vehicle)
desc: Driving a car above the prescribed speed limit on highways or city roads.

title: No Parking Violation
desc: Parking in a 'No Parking' zone around the Meenakshi Temple and central market areas. Vehicle may be towed.

title: Dangerous / Rash Driving
desc: Driving in a manner that poses a threat to the public, including racing and weaving through traffic.

title: Wrong Way Driving on One-Way
desc: Driving against the designated flow of traffic on a one-way street.

title: Defective Number Plate
desc: Displaying a number plate that is not HSRP, illegible, or has unauthorized names/graphics.

title: Overloading (Goods Vehicle)
desc: Carrying load exceeding the permissible gross vehicle weight limit.

title: School Bus Safety Violation
desc: School bus operating without speed governor, attendant, or missing 'School Bus' markings.
